description: Parameters of 4-states round-rotor synchronous machine with quadratic/exponential saturation: IEEE Std 1110 5.3.2 (Model 2.2). GENROU or GENROE model in PSSE and PSLF

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

Td0_p.description: Time constant of transient d-axis voltage. Units: s.

Td0_pp.description: Time constant of sub-transient d-axis voltage. Units: s.

Tq0_p.description: Time constant of transient q-axis voltage. Units: s.

Tq0_pp.description: Time constant of sub-transient q-axis voltage. Units: s.

Xd.description: Reactance after EMF in d-axis. Units: pu.

Xq.description: Reactance after EMF in q-axis. Units: pu.

Xd_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis. Units: pu.

Xq_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in q-axis. Units: pu.

Xd_pp.description: Sub-Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis. Note: Xd_pp = Xq_pp. Units: pu.

Se.description: Saturation factor at 1 and 1.2 pu flux: S(1.0) = B(|psi_pp|-A)^2

title: RoundRotorMachine
